'''Bardian Aelto''' was a junior<ref name="Codex" /> [[Chemist/Legends|chemist]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Holonet" /> on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Codex" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Holonet" /> Aelto worked briefly on various projects researching the stimulants known as [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenals]] before he was assigned to review the files on planets to determine whether they were habitable. When he was studying chemical scans from the planet [[Quesh]] one night, Aelto recognized a molecular chain from his work on adrenals&mdash;a chain found in a compound virtually identical to ''[[venenit shadaaga]]'', a major ingredient in adrenals that was also known as [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] venom. The similar chemical, which Aelto dubbed ''[[venenit queshaaga]]'', or "Quesh venom," could be converted to a usable compound through a simple chemical process, and as a result of his research, the Republic established [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations on Quesh.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bardian Aelto was first mentioned on [[the Holonet]] portion of the official site<ref name="Holonet" /> for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and he was first named in the game's Codex entry for Quesh venom.<ref name="Codex" />
